title: Remove Sub Folders From The Filesystem
statement:
Given unique absolute folder paths, remove every path that is a subfolder of another listed path. A path is a subfolder only when it begins with the parent path followed by `/`. Return the remaining folder paths in lexicographic order.

## Examples

```text
Input: folder = ["/a", "/a/b", "/c/d", "/c/d/e", "/c/f"]
Output: ["/a", "/c/d", "/c/f"]
```

```text
Input: folder = ["/a", "/a/b/c", "/a/b/d"]
Output: ["/a"]
```

```text
Input: folder = ["/a/b/c", "/a/b/ca", "/a/b/d"]
Output: ["/a/b/c", "/a/b/ca", "/a/b/d"]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= folder.length <= 4 * 10^4`
- `2 <= folder[i].length <= 100`
- Paths start with `/` and contain lowercase English letters and `/` only.
- All paths are unique.
